title: fetchBaseQuery treats falsy responseHandler rejection reasons as success
author: JunaidAhamed-7777
body_preview: ### Description  A custom `responseHandler` that throws or rejects with a falsy value is treated as a successful response by `fetchBaseQuery`. For example, `Promise.reject(undefined)` produces a result with `data: undefined` for an HTTP 200 response instead of `PARSING_ERROR`. The same happens with `null`, `false`, `0`, `''`, and `NaN`.  ### Reproduction  Reproduced against `master` at `0fd611cc79...
